entities.name: Peptide methionine sulfoxide reductase MsrB
observations: The 142-residue query sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed Staphylococcus aureus MsrB proteins Q2FH15, P0A088, and A6QGX4.
MsrB catalyzes reduction of peptide-bound methionine-R-sulfoxide to methionine as part of oxidative protein repair.
The protein is associated with protein repair and response to oxidative stress.
The query contains the SelR/MsrB domain PF01641 spanning residues 9–124.

entities.name: MsrB sequence properties
observations: The query protein is 142 amino acids long with estimated molecular weight 16.28 kDa.
The predicted theoretical pI is 4.76 and estimated charge at pH 7 is -12.04.
The sequence is hydrophilic overall with GRAVY -0.601 and has no signal peptide or transmembrane segment reported by the analysis.

entities.name: Oxidative protein repair
observations: MsrB participates in repair of oxidatively damaged proteins by reducing peptide methionine-R-sulfoxide.
The associated biological process is response to oxidative stress.
